shared_elements: animal or creature figures with prominent heads
a horizontal band of repeated geometric motifs crossing the composition
frontal/profile faces or muzzles rendered schematically
strong vertical central element (the pillar shaft / the central painted panel)
figures arranged in registers or tiers
justification: The only reasonably specific correspondence is that both surfaces carry a horizontal band of repeated geometric motifs running across the middle, with creature figures above and below it and a dominant vertical axis. Otherwise they differ fundamentally: A is a monochrome, low-relief carving on stone with asymmetric, loosely stacked animal figures, while B is a flat, brightly polychrome painted disc built on strict bilateral symmetry around a central panel with two mirrored anthropomorphic figures.
